description: This file implements a SOCKS proxy server and client logic, including connection handling, pattern matching for proxy rules, and event-driven communication for socket requests, data transfer, and errors within the Playwright core server utilities.

classes.name: SocksConnection
classes.description: Handles individual SOCKS protocol connection, including authentication, request parsing, and data forwarding.

classes.name: SocksProxy
classes.description: Implements a SOCKS proxy server, managing incoming connections, pattern-based routing, and event emission for socket activities.

classes.name: SocksProxyHandler
classes.description: Manages SOCKS socket requests, applies pattern matching for routing, and emits events for socket lifecycle and data transfer.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern for proxy routing rules.

methods.name: _handleDirect
methods.description: Handles direct socket connection bypassing the proxy based on request.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Returns the port number the proxy server is listening on.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the proxy server listening on a specified port and optional hostname.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the proxy server and all active sockets.

methods.name: onSocketRequested
methods.description: Handles incoming socket request events, routing through pattern matching.

methods.name: onSocketData
methods.description: Handles incoming data from sockets and emits appropriate events.

methods.name: onSocketClosed
methods.description: Handles socket closure events and cleans up resources.

methods.name: sendSocketData
methods.description: Sends data through a specified socket.
